'''Optical camouflage system''' was a type of [[Armor/Legends|armor]] [[Armor accessory|enhancement]] available during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]] between the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Alliance to Restore the Republic]] and the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] following the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]]. The system consisted of image generators and sound reducers. Several models of system were available, all costing about 5500 [[Galactic Credit Standard/Legends|credits]]; these included [[BioTech Industries/Legends|BioTech Industries's]] [[Flicker displacement field]], [[Merr-Sonn Munitions, Inc./Legends|Merr-Sonn Munitions, Inc.'s]] [["Ghost" optical camouflage system]] and [[Atlas Corp]]'s [["Smokescreen" stealth system]].
